tooltip.runic.attribute_desc.sealed: Prevents further modification at the Artisan's Workbench.
tooltip.runic.attribute_desc.cursed: Reduces runic stat values and makes future changes more dangerous.
tooltip.runic.attribute_desc.instable: Raises forging risk and weakens future rerolls.
tooltip.runic.attribute_desc.negative: Reduces effective rune slot capacity by 1 per stack.
tooltip.runic.attribute_desc.ancient: Boosts all rune power on the item.
tooltip.runic.attribute_desc.fractured: Failed synergy attempts add additional corruption.
tooltip.runic.attribute_desc.exhausted: Maximum corruption reached. Runic modification is blocked.
tooltip.runic.attribute_desc.chaotic: Wild modifications have made this item unpredictable.
tooltip.runic.attribute_desc.overforged: Further stat upgrades add additional corruption.
tooltip.runic.bane_of_arthropods: Deal more damage to arthropod type enemies
tooltip.runic.chill_aura: Slows nearby enemies with freezing aura
tooltip.runic.cursed_inscription: Attempts to force a stat beyond its limit. Failure curses and damages the item.
tooltip.runic.expansion_rune: Adds an enhancement slot at the cost of durability and corruption.
tooltip.runic.extraction_inscription: Extracts one enhancement, sealing the item and increasing corruption.
tooltip.runic.fire_protection: Reduces fire damage and burn time
tooltip.runic.infinity: 50/50 chance to not consume an arrow
tooltip.runic.mending: Uses XP to repair the item
tooltip.runic.mystical_enlightenment: Boosts enchanting power of nearby tables
tooltip.runic.nullification_rune: Removes enhancements, but damages the item's capacity and increases corruption.
tooltip.runic.potato_recovery: % chance to not consume a potato
tooltip.runic.purification_inscription: Removes one negative attribute, but increases corruption and may reduce durability.
tooltip.runic.relic_socket_inscription: Adds a relic socket, allowing one future relic to be bound to the item.
tooltip.runic.repair_rune: Reduces corruption at the cost of maximum durability.
tooltip.runic.reroll_inscription: Rerolls a stat enhancement. Better outcomes may destabilize the item.
tooltip.runic.resonance_inscription: Increases Synergy Potential by 1, but fractures the item and increases corruption.
tooltip.runic.stabilization_inscription: Stabilizes an item at the cost of brittleness and corruption.
tooltip.runic.riptide: Propels the player in water or rain
tooltip.runic.skulk_smite: Deals extra damage to sculk creatures
tooltip.runic.soul_siphoner: % chance to siphon extra soul essence
tooltip.runic.stat_desc.aegis: Chance to negate an incoming hit.
tooltip.runic.stat_desc.fangs: Chance to summon a line of evoker fangs on hit.
tooltip.runic.stat_desc.leeching_chance: Chance to leach 10% of enemy max health on critical hit.
tooltip.runic.stat_desc.stone: Gain temporary resistance after a heavy hit.
tooltip.runic.synergy_desc.berserk: Sustained aggression grants a temporary burst of movement and mining speed.
tooltip.runic.synergy_desc.bloodfire: Bleeding enemies ignite, and burning enemies can begin bleeding for chained fire and bleed pressure.
tooltip.runic.synergy_desc.corrosion: Poisoned enemies take bonus damage that partially ignores armor.
tooltip.runic.synergy_desc.executioners_: Finishing low-health enemies grants a temporary damage surge.
tooltip.runic.synergy_desc.frostbite: Bleeding enemies freeze more easily and take bonus pressure while chilled.
tooltip.runic.synergy_desc.ice_prison: Frozen enemies trap nearby foes in ice, slowing and marking them as frozen.
tooltip.runic.synergy_desc.juggernaut: Taking a heavy hit briefly grants strong resistance and knockback control.
tooltip.runic.synergy_desc.reaper: Executing weakened enemies restores health and briefly hastens your next attacks.
tooltip.runic.synergy_desc.shatter: Frozen enemies release an electric burst when struck, damaging nearby enemies after a short cooldown.
tooltip.runic.synergy_desc.soulburn: Burning enemies mark themselves, then release a withering pulse on death.
tooltip.runic.synergy_desc.tempest: Rapid strikes build static charge, then release chain lightning into nearby enemies.
tooltip.runic.synergy_desc.venom_burst: Poisoned enemies can erupt, spreading poison and lightning-like damage to nearby targets.
tooltip.runic.tempering_inscription: Reinforces an item, reducing durability loss but increasing corruption.
tooltip.runic.upgrade_rune: Pushes a stat enhancement higher, increasing corruption and marking the item as Overforged.
tooltip.runic.wild_inscription: Mutates one enhancement into another of the same category, adding corruption and chaos.
tooltip.runic.wind_burst: Summons a wind charge on attack
message.runic.no_relic_socket: This item has no relic socket.
message.runic.relic_socket_filled: This item already contains a relic.
warning.runic.this_will_exhaust: Warning: This will Exhaust the item.
tooltip.runic.relic_desc.dragon_heart: Empowers fire-based effects and rewards aggressive burning builds, but increases durability use and corruption.
tooltip.runic.relic_desc.elder_guardians: Improves underwater combat and mining, with stronger benefits while fighting in water.
tooltip.runic.relic_desc.wither_charge: Extends wither effects and increases damage against withered enemies.
tooltip.runic.relic_desc.wardens_soul: Improves damage against powerful enemies and rewards fighting high-health targets.
tooltip.runic.mythic_desc.ruin: Greatly increases weapon damage. Hits may add extra corruption, and the item uses more durability.
tooltip.runic.mythic_desc.dominion: Amplifies the power of other enhancements and synergies on this item.
tooltip.runic.mythic_desc.hunger: Restores durability on kills, but attacks can add extra corruption as the rune feeds.
tooltip.runic.mythic_desc.void: Deals more damage to weakened targets and builds corruption while the item remains in combat.
tooltip.runic.mythic_desc.ascendance: Defeating powerful enemies briefly grants strength and speed.
message.runic.mythic_already_present: This item already has that Mythic rune.
message.runic.mythic_wrong_item: That Mythic rune cannot be applied to this item.
